summary: Places Input 1 under Input 2, using Input 2 alpha to determine which parts of Input 1 remain visible.

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Fixed layer that defines final resolution/aspect

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Fit behavior for the overlay before compositing

common_gotchas: Input 2 alpha controls visibility of Input 1; this is not equivalent to swapping inputs on Over TOP in every pipeline.
Fixed Layer chooses output dimensions and which layer is adjustable, but it does not change compositing order.
Transform parameters affect only the overlay layer, not the fixed layer.
Input 2 with fully opaque alpha will hide the corresponding Input 1 areas.
Legacy Transform uses older rotation and transform-order behavior.
key_concepts: Under TOP composites Input 1 beneath Input 2, using Input 2 alpha to reveal or hide Input 1.
Fixed Layer controls final resolution/aspect and which input is transformed, not the core under compositing order.
Prefit, justify, extend, and transform parameters are applied to the overlay layer only.
The operator supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
